email_subject: Application - Paid Search / SEA Specialist (Activation team)
email_body:
Dear WPP Media team,

I'm applying for the Paid Search / SEA Specialist role in your Activation team. You asked for one account or campaign I actually ran, so here it is.

At Episto, I took over a client site with a flat structure and no conversion tracking. I rebuilt the Google Ads account around intent-based campaigns, cleaned up the keyword list, and set up conversion tracking. I also built a WordPress landing page to match the new ad copy. Within three months, cost per lead dropped by 40% and lead volume doubled. Along the way, I wasted budget on broad match keywords that looked good in theory but brought in unqualified traffic. I learned to check search terms weekly and cut what doesn't convert.

I have 2+ years of hands-on SEA work across Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising, and GA4, plus SEO and GEO experience. I'm based in Zwijndrecht, speak English and Turkish, and my Dutch is B1 and improving.

I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute to your team.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
linkedin.com/in/baverok

PROFILE
Junior digital marketer with 2+ years of hands-on SEA work across Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising, and GA4. At Episto, I run paid search campaigns for client sites, from account structure and keyword research to ad copy testing and performance reporting.
